title: The five conversion presets
description: Each button is one `--preset`. All five are calibrated to the same target — scene mid-grey 0.18 delivered at 0.223, the brightness approved on 2026-09-09 — so brightness is held constant and what differs is the reconstruction and the display tone. chr-generic is the proposed default. Two of them change the display stage as well as the curve: sig-knees applies no display tone at all (the sigmoid's own shoulder does that work), while the other four use extended Reinhard at 6 stops. Each button is `nc convert --preset <name>` and nothing else — the exposure and the density scale come from the preset.

configs.label: chr generic
configs.note: characteristic curve, no --film-stock: the average of nine published sheets — --preset characteristic-generic

configs.label: chr stock
configs.note: characteristic curve, the roll's own published response — --preset characteristic-stock

configs.label: chr aim
configs.note: characteristic-stock plus the aim-matched red density scale — --preset characteristic-aim

configs.label: sig knees + linear
configs.note: sigmoid with its toe/shoulder, no display tone curve; brightness from the anchor — --preset sigmoid-knees

configs.label: sig flat + reinhard
configs.note: sigmoid with neither knee, character carried by extended Reinhard — --preset sigmoid-flat
